evals.prompt: I solved a few problems this week, write the DSA notes.
evals.expected_output: Lists solved problems missing NOTES.md, spawns one dsa-notes-writer per problem, refreshes code/README.md, commits only code/.
assertions: Runs `python3 -m clients.dsa_sheet missing` before spawning agents
Spawns dsa-notes-writer agents, up to 5 per batch
Never modifies the user's solution files
Stages only the code/ directory when committing

evals.prompt: Start the two-sum problem from my A2Z sheet.
evals.expected_output: Runs the start command and reports the created folder path without writing a solution.
assertions: Runs `python3 -m clients.dsa_sheet start` with the slug or id
Does not write solution code for the user

evals.prompt: Sync my Code folder with the latest Striver sheet.
evals.expected_output: Runs the sync command via Arc, leaves existing solution folders intact, and reports counts.
assertions: Does not delete existing solution folders
